title: GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times Revealed: Xbox New Zealand Trick
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Unlock times vary globally, and Xbox players can seemingly use the New Zealand trick.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times and Release Details

Grand Theft Auto 6 is officially arriving on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, according to recent reports from Eurogamer. As one of the most anticipated releases in gaming history, the countdown to launch is heating up. However, exactly when players around the globe will actually get to dive into the action depends heavily on their geographic location.

## Regional Unlock Variations

While the November 19 release date is locked in for both major console platforms, the exact moment the game becomes playable varies depending on where you are in the world. Different time zones and regional rollouts mean that some players will gain access earlier than others based purely on their local time.

## The Return of the Classic Xbox Trick

Adding an interesting twist to the launch preparations, Eurogamer notes that Xbox owners can seemingly still use the old New Zealand trick to play early. This well-known method has been utilized by the Xbox community for numerous major game launches over the years, allowing players to shift their console's region settings to gain access ahead of their local time zones.

## Editor's Take

The anticipation surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to reach unprecedented heights as we approach the November 19 launch. Whether the classic New Zealand region workaround ultimately functions seamlessly for Xbox users or not, the staggered global unlock times ensure that the gaming community will experience a massive, synchronized wave of excitement on release day.
